task.description:
ADHOC: TEST-RUNNER pre-checks failed for WF03-GH533 — BPM_TEST_DB_URL points to port 5433 but db_test container is on 5434.

Tasks (autonomous, no user interaction):
1. Verify docker-compose ps shows db_test on 5434: docker port $(docker ps -q -f name=db_test) 5432
2. Set BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test for the current shell session (or document the canonical env command).
3. Run zig build migrate 2>&1 — must exit 0 with no AuthenticationFailed.
4. Run zig build test-env-verify — must exit 0.
5. Verify psql $BPM_TEST_DB_URL -c 'SELECT 1' works.
6. Print the verified env vars for ORCH to redispatch TEST-RUNNER.

Return PASS only when all of the above work. Do NOT modify code.
acceptance_criteria: BPM_TEST_DB_URL confirmed to use port 5434 in verified session

result.summary: Port mismatch fixed: BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test is verified for the r-co-db_test-1 container (host port 5434 -> container 5432). Acceptance criteria 1, 3, 4 PASS; criterion 2 (zig build test-env-verify exits 0) FAILS on check C4 (schema baseline), which reports 5 tenant rows in public.tenant whose Postgres schemas are missing. C4 is a pre-existing, port-unrelated defect — the port change alone cannot resolve it (see Result Notes). Filed as ISS-0605 / GH #537 and added to the global queue per CLAUDE.md 'scope boundary — blocking vs. adjacent' directive. NOT fixed in this run (source code modification is explicitly forbidden by the handoff, and schema remediation requires product-owner decision on whether to delete the orphaned tenant rows).
